name: Nakamura Yoshisada
source: A boy who becomes interested in Hakuki, a young miko that visits the influential Nakamura estate to cure Lord Nakamura. Yoshisada treats her like a normal girl and even shows his clumsier side in front of her, contrasting with the way most people act around the priestess.
